channel.title: Francois Gerber - Software Developer
channel.description: I am a determined Software Developer who is passionate about my work. I enjoy solving problems, furthering my knowledge in my field and is passionate about learning something new every day. I strive to achieve the best results in the work I am tasked with. I have knowledge in Data Driven Software Solutions and specializes in the .NET Core and Framework Web Stack. I enjoy working both individually and in teams, is always willing to learn and finds pleasure in assisting others achieve their goals. I identify and resolve problems quickly, am solutions driven and stands out as a leader.
